instructions: Medify is an offline-first Flutter medicine reminder app (Clean Architecture, Cubit, GetIt, ObjectBox). Prefer correctness around scheduling, notifications, permissions, local DB, and adherence tracking. Avoid style nits covered by flutter_lints. Flag regressions that reintroduce CocoaPods, weaken privacy/offline guarantees, or break medicine/log state sync.

rules.rule: Keep medicine and dose data local (ObjectBox / SharedPreferences). Do not introduce cloud sync or third-party analytics without explicit product intent.
Notification and permission changes must preserve Taken/Skip/Snooze actions and avoid silently dropping scheduled reminders.
Do not reintroduce CocoaPods (Podfile, Pods xcconfig includes, [CP] build phases). iOS dependencies use Swift Package Manager.
Respect COMMENTED OUT FOR UPCOMING RELEASE blocks (profiles, refill UI, CSV export). Do not silently re-enable without matching product scope.
